summary: Piedmont Realty Trust filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing the pricing of a $200 million offering of 2.875% exchangeable senior notes due 2031 issued by Piedmont Operating Partnership, LP and guaranteed senior unsecured by the Company. The notes were sold to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. Settlement is scheduled for September 17, 2026. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation; no deal terms such as exchange price or premium were disclosed in the excerpt.
